job: Bind rail-inhibit thresholds to the retained audio signal target and assess warning-time feasibility before choosing a mute circuit.
cm_basis: TI OPA2134 SBOS058B table5.7 at25C/+/-15V lists input range V-+2.5 to V+-3.5. Applying these offsets during rail decay is an engineering screening allocation, not a new full-temperature guarantee.
regulator_basis: ST L7815C table16 and L7915C table9 at stated load/input/temperature limits. These are not guarantees outside the documented input range or of a particular shutdown waveform.
capacitor_basis: Uniform +/-20 percent sensitivity allowance only; exact ESR, temperature, ageing, wire impedance and remaining regulator/backfeed current are not represented.
limitations: 10Vpeak is the existing design target, not a measured tank signal or mandatory instantaneous voltage during every fault.
Normal startup/power-down and control switching need qualification; no requirement for absolute silence under every arbitrary internal hard fault is invented here.

A warning-time estimate after loss of regulator feed assumes isolated rail capacitance and constant load. Actual raw reservoir, regulator, protection diode, harness and reference sequencing remain to model or measure.
Current reserve scenarios are inherited planning loads, not a qualified maximum audio or fault-current budget.
Hypothetical delays and warning floors do not select a comparator, relay release time, JFET or new capacitor.
No native circuit, PCB, functional-block, socket, cabinet or fabrication change.
